description: The shared Renovate preset of the whatsaaaa repositories

packageRules.description: Every non-major update of a repository in one pull request a week, so its CI runs once for all of them
Our own packages: one group, raised as soon as they are published, as pnpm's minimumReleaseAgeExclude lets them in
Template updates come from our own template, whose git tags carry no release time to wait on. They stay a pull request of their own, raised right away
Workflow and action refs into whatsaaaa/template move with copier update, together with the callers that use them
Only Docker Hub reports when an image was pushed: images from other registries, like the Playwright one, are raised without the wait instead of never
The @tsconfig/node bases follow the Node versions a repository supports, not the newest Node: no replacement PRs
